description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'DittoHeadersTooLargeException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It handles cases where headers are too large to communicate within the cluster, providing builder methods for different scenarios and JSON serialization support.

classes.name: DittoHeadersTooLargeException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException that represents an exception when headers exceed size limits. It includes constants for error codes and message patterns, factory methods for builder creation, JSON deserialization, and overrides setDittoHeaders method.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A private static nested class extending DittoRuntimeExceptionBuilder, providing a fluent API to construct instances of DittoHeadersTooLargeException with default and custom data.

methods.name: newSizeLimitBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder with a message indicating headers size exceeded a maximum byte size.

methods.name: newAuthSubjectsLimitBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder with a message indicating authorization subjects count exceeded limits.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an exception instance from a JSON object and headers, deserializing the error message.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to create a new exception with potentially updated headers, maintaining other properties.
